# Harry Potter House Quiz Skill

This skill runs a short, unofficial quiz in chat and tells you which Hogwarts house fits you best, for fun only. It asks ten original questions one by one, adds up your answers by trait, and gives you one house with a short explanation. It is not an official quiz, and it is not a real personality test.

Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Warner Bros. No official text, image, or quiz is copied here. Just for fun, not a real personality test.
